given_when_then.given: An authorized actor initiates the creation of a new customer account
given_when_then.when: The actor enters valid unique identifiers and contact details
given_when_then.then: The system creates a new Customer Profile with an active status and links it to the actor's session

success_criteria: Customer Profile is updated with new address changes and preference updates when valid data is provided by an authorized actor
Modification to Customer Profile is timestamped and attributed to the actor performing the change
Archived Customer Profiles cannot be modified and retain all historical data after archival
Contact details within a Customer Profile must be verified before the profile status is set to active
System rejects update requests with invalid data and displays a specific error message indicating the validation failure
New Customer Profile is created with active status and linked to the actor's session when valid unique identifiers and contact details are entered
